intent: Trace the inflation-adjusted price of the popular chair from 1990 to 2015 and quantify how much it changed over that period.

requirements.question: Are all required line series shown in every declared panel?
What is the overall trend of the inflation-adjusted chair price from 1990 to 2015?
How much did the inflation-adjusted chair price change from 1990 to 2015?

units.claim: All 1 required series appear in panel single chart.
accept: every required series is visible and correctly labeled in this panel
reject: series assigned to the wrong panel

units.claim: The inflation-adjusted chair price generally declined from 1990 to 2015, with an initial rise to a peak around point_order 3 before falling substantially.
units.computation: Compare values across the ordered sequence: 294.9891 at 1990, peak 335.0109 at point_order 3, 105.0000 at point_order 11, and 25.0326 at 2015; overall direction is downward after the early peak.
accept: There is an initial increase to a peak before a sustained decline.
The line ends much lower than it starts.
reject: Price steadily increases throughout the period.
There is no overall downward movement.
The highest value occurs at the final year.

units.claim: The inflation-adjusted chair price decreased from $294.9891 in 1990 to $25.0326 in 2015, an absolute drop of $269.9565 (about 91.5%).
accept: The 2015 value is $25.0326 compared with $294.9891 in 1990.
reject: The price increased over the period.

optional_valid: Mentioning the peak value of $335.0109 at point_order 3 as context for the decline.
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal explanations for the price decline.
Claims about years not present in the table.
Comparing this series to another entity or panel.
review_notes: The table has 23 rows but only 1990 and 2015 have explicit x labels; intermediate x values are blank, so trend evidence uses point_order sequence.
The intent asks for both tracing the trend and quantifying the change, yielding two semantic units.
